COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
CRJA No.42 of 2020
Hon'ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Pooran Singh Rawat, learned Amicus
Curiae for the appellant.
Mr. T.C. Aggarwal, learned Deputy Advocate
General along with Mr. Sachin Panwar, learned
Brief Holder for the State.

Subsequent to the appointment of the Amicus
Curiae in preferring the Criminal Jail Appeal No.42
of 2020 as against the Sessions Trial No.2 of 2013,
"State Vs. Rahmat Ali", the appellant therein has
preferred a Criminal Jail Appeal No.13 of 2021
through private counsel Shri H.C. Pathak and Shri
B.D. Pande. Both the criminal jail appeals are
arising out of the same judgment of conviction.
Since the appellant has engaged a private
counsel for pursuing Criminal Jail Appeal No.13 of
2021, no orders are required to be passed in
Criminal Jail Appeal No.42 of 2020, which is being
represented by the Amicus Curiae.
Thus, Criminal Jail Appeal No.42 of 2020
would stand dismissed without having any adverse
bearing on the pending Criminal Jail Appeal No.13
of 2021.
